heading: INT. FIDELITY PRUDENTIAL MUTUAL, CLAIMS DEPARTMENT - DAY

units.text: INT. FIDELITY PRUDENTIAL MUTUAL, CLAIMS DEPARTMENT - DAY
A sea of identical desks and green-shaded lamps.
Typewriters clatter in unison.
Above the manager's glass-walled office hangs a banner: A SMILE IS A CLAIM WELL-FILED.
MISS GWENDOLYN TILLMAN (30s, cat-eye glasses, ledger in hand) stands before the manager's desk.
Behind it sits MR. HORATIO PEMBERTON-HALE (50s, pinstripe, pencil moustache), who hasn't looked up from his blotter.
A MAN IN A GRAY SUIT (40s, bowler, no briefcase) stands at the window with his back to them.
Miss Tillman, your productivity is down four percent.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: Mr. Pemberton-Hale, I processed eleven hundred claims.
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: Eleven hundred and four were expected.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: There were four holidays.
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: Then the holidays are down four percent.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: He still hasn't looked up.
The Man in the Gray Suit turns from the window, smiling at no one.
Don't mind me.
units.name: GRAY MAN

units.text: We don't.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: The desk phone rings.
Pemberton-Hale lifts it without taking his eyes from the blotter.
Claims.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: Horatio. It's Head Office. Is the efficiency man there yet?
units.name: VOICE

units.text: Who?
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: The efficiency man. Mr. Alistair Voss. Gray suit, bowler. He's to review the department.
units.name: VOICE

units.text: Pemberton-Hale's pencil stops.
He looks up, slowly, past Gwendolyn, to the man at the window.
I'll call you back.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: He hangs up.
Rises.
The Man in the Gray Suit takes off his bowler.
Mr. Voss.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: Please. Sit. I've been enjoying the show.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: Pemberton-Hale does not sit.
Neither does Gwendolyn, who has quietly put down her ledger and folded her hands behind her back.
Tell me, Mr. Pemberton-Hale, how many of your employees are four percent down?
units.name: VOSS

units.text: One. Miss Tillman.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: And how many are four percent up?
units.name: VOSS

units.text: None.
units.name: PEMBERTON-HALE

units.text: Then the department is meeting target.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: Pemberton-Hale's mouth opens, closes.
Gwendolyn picks up her ledger and walks to the door.
Excuse me. I have eleven hundred claims to file.
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: She closes the glass door behind her very gently.
Through the glass, the typewriters clatter on.
